Title: Logistics Optimization Manager
Description:
Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Accountability Areas**
**BI, Data Visualization & AI-based Automations**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards and automated reporting pipelines covering fleet performance, delivery speed, order stacking, cost per delivery, and rider utilization
* Own the end-to-end data lifecycle: from raw data extraction (SQL, BigQuery) through to business-ready visualizations (Tableau, Looker, Data Studio)
* Automate recurring logistics reports to reduce manual data pulling and free leadership time for decision-making
* Develop predictive models and forecasting tools for demand planning, supply crunch detection, and staffing efficiency
* Translate complex, large-scale datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for logistics and operations stakeholders

**Logistics Optimization and Utilization**

* Reduce delivery time across all stages: from order dispatch through to delivery, by identifying bottlenecks across the multiple DT sub-metrics
* Collaborate with dispatching and algorithm teams to enhance order assignment logic and improve on-time delivery rates
* Monitor and improve order stacking efficiency without compromising delivery SLAs
* Track NPS and customer experience metrics tied to logistics performance, identifying drivers of dissatisfaction
* Own analysis of logistics failures across vendor operations, rider operations, and customer touchpoints; recommend and execute fixes
* Collaborate with workforce planning to optimise shift models, staffing levels, and on-demand-to-shift model transitions
* Identify demand patterns and partner with growth and marketing teams to improve forecasting accuracy
* Support rider hiring, onboarding, and payment process analysis to reduce attrition and improve supply reliability

**Product Operations – Local & Global Rollouts**

* Act as the logistics liaison between local business stakeholders, local operations teams, and global product teams
* Gather operational pain points, feature requests, and platform feedback; translate these into structured business cases for product prioritisation
* Lead go-to-market (GTM) execution for new logistics initiatives: coordinating timelines, stakeholders, training materials, and deployment playbooks.
* Support rollout and adoption of tools, ensuring operational readiness and post-launch performance tracking
* Track rollout KPIs, adoption rates, and feedback loops, and present findings to product and logistics leadership

**Logistics Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support**

* Serve as the first escalation point for logistics issues: diagnosing root causes, mobilizing fixes, and communicating resolution timelines.
* Manage performance during high-demand periods, including holidays, national days, and weekends, with proactive monitoring frameworks.
* Coordinate with central/regional logistics and product teams (e.g. Delivery Hero central) to implement platform-wide improvements locally.
* Minimize wastage per order through operational audits and targeted efficiency initiatives.
* Provide training, change management support, and communications for stakeholder transitions tied to new logistics models or tools

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS**
**Knowledge And Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in logistics analytics, operations, product operations, or a related field, preferably within food delivery, quick commerce, or a high-growth tech platform.
* Proven track record in at least two of: BI/analytics delivery, logistics optimization, and product rollout execution.
* Experience working in multi-market or global organizations with cross-functional, matrixed team structures.
* Exposure to rider/fleet operations, last-mile delivery dynamics, and demand-supply management is strongly preferred
* Exposure to A/B testing frameworks and statistical significance analysis in an operational context.
* Advanced SQL proficiency, can write complex queries from scratch and independently pull your own data.
* Strong experience with data visualization platforms: Tableau, Looker, Google Data Studio, or equivalent.
* Comfortable with Python or R for automation, modeling, or data transformation.
* Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools: Jira, Confluence, Notion, Asana

**Education and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Master's degree in a relevant field is a plus

Description:

Toronto Community Housing Corporation (“TCHC”) is the largest social housing provider in Canada and the second largest in North America. We are wholly owned by the City of Toronto and operate in a non-profit manner. TCHC provides homes to over 41,000 low and moderate-income households in 88 of Toronto's neighbourhoods, with 93,000 tenants from many different backgrounds with a diversity in age, education, language, mental and physical ability, religion, ethnicity and race. We are an essential part of the City of Toronto's fabric and social system.
  
  
Our over 2,000 employees work to achieve our vision of quality homes in vibrant communities where people are proud to live and work.
  
  
**Vacancy Type:** Full-time Permanent
  
**Salary/Hourly Range:** $142,987.19 - $157,285.91

The Senior Manager, Procurement is accountable for following all process and policy guidelines throughout the sourcing process and collaborate closely with divisional heads to ensure business needs are being managed proactively and efficiently.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**Strategy and Planning:**  

* Oversee multi-year category planning and procurement pipeline development led by Category Managers, ensuring alignment with divisional needs and contract expiry timelines.
* Review category and sourcing strategies, demand forecasts, and category roadmaps to validate priorities and closely manage high-risk/high-impact initiatives.
* Monitor request volume and trends across strategic and transactional procurement intake to inform resource planning, role delegation, and process improvements.

* Act as the senior escalation point for governance around complex procurement issues, including sourcing delays, vendor engagement concerns, non-compliance in sourcing process, risk scenarios or special divisional request requiring senior judgement.

* Collaborate with the Centre of Excellence to refine sourcing templates, procurement protocols/policies, and intake tools, as needed.
* Represent the procurement function in cross-functional leadership discussions, strategic planning sessions, and major project reviews.

**Performance Management and Continuous Improvement:**  

* Monitor team performance, workload distribution, and compliance using reports from the analytics team; address bottlenecks or gaps in process.
* Oversee and monitor systemic risks in sourcing or purchasing and lead the implementation of mitigation strategies.
* Facilitate staff development, onboarding, and cross-training to build procurement capacity and improve service delivery, with support from the Centre of Excellence.

* Bachelor’s (Masters preferred) in business or relevant discipline or a combination of education and/or equivalent procurement sourcing work experience
* Advanced public procurement training or experience with a focus on category management and strategic sourcing
* Minimum 7 years (10+ years preferred) strategic sourcing procurement in a large/complex environment preferably in the facilities maintenance and construction industry with majority of the experience
* 3 years of cumulative experience building category strategies and conducting strategic sourcing focused on value creation.
* Extensive experience in report writing for executive audiences and stakeholder coordination.in public procurement experience and formal people leadership.
* Ability to work and navigate effectively in a complex organization projecting ethical leadership.

Title: Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships
Description:
Calix is seeking an established property ecosystem and strategic partnerships leader to develop and manage relationships with organizations that own, develop, operate, manage, build, renovate, and influence technology deployment within the Managed Business ecosystem.  
Reporting to the Area Vice President, Managed Services Ecosystem & Partner Programs, the Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships will own the Property & Development Ecosystem across four strategic customer segments: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.  
The successful candidate will bring substantial expertise and active executive and operational relationships within at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with adjacent segments, and the ability to identify the organizations that exert the greatest influence over property development, capital planning, operating standards, procurement, technology selection, deployment, and managed-service adoption. This is not a role in which the core market network and domain expertise will be developed after joining Calix.  
The role will identify, prioritize, recruit, and manage the property and development organizations most important to Calix's Managed Business strategy. The role will translate these relationships into market insight, Product Group requirements, segment priorities, and repeatable opportunities for MSP and related channel partners. The role will also collaborate with Marketing on segment positioning, market activation, executive engagement, and ecosystem programs.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Property & Development Partner Strategy**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain a prioritized partner strategy for each target customer segment.
* Apply existing market knowledge and relationships to identify the organizations and decision-makers with the greatest strategic relevance to Calix.
* Evaluate prospective partners using criteria such as property or venue footprint, development and renovation pipeline, operating influence, technology authority, market access, channel fit, strategic alignment, and ability to scale.
* Recommend where Calix should invest, where Calix should monitor, and where Calix should not pursue a relationship.
* Build segment-level ecosystem maps, partner portfolios, engagement plans, and relationship roadmaps.
* Continuously assess ownership trends, acquisition and redevelopment activity, operator shifts, consolidation, capital plans, procurement practices, and emerging market participants.

**Strategic Partner Development & Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Use an established network to open and accelerate relationships with senior leaders, operating executives, development leaders, technology decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, and design-build participants at priority organizations.
* Recruit, develop, and manage selected organizations within the Property & Development Ecosystem across the four customer segments.
* Establish shared objectives, executive sponsorship, operating cadences, mutual commitments, and measurable success criteria with priority partners.
* Coordinate relationship activity across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Sales, Operations, Legal, and technical stakeholders.
* Develop opportunities for market development, solution validation, design influence, joint education, reference architectures, property pilots, executive engagement, and other mutually beneficial initiatives.
* Maintain an accurate view of partner strategy, organizational dynamics, development and operating priorities, decision processes, and relationship health.

**MSP Route-to-Market Activation**
----------------------------------

* Partner with the MSP ecosystem team, Sales, and Business Development to convert property and development relationships into qualified, scalable opportunities for MSPs and related channel partners.
* Define clear engagement models, account roles, ownership boundaries, mutual value, and handoff processes among Calix, property ecosystem partners, and service-delivery partners.
* Identify repeatable demand-generation and deployment patterns that can be operationalized through MSP specializations, enablement, solution plays, and partner programs.
* Ensure that ecosystem activity supports an indirect route to market rather than creating an uncoordinated direct-sales motion.

**Product Group Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Serve as the primary ecosystem advisor to the Product Group for property, development, ownership, operating, and design-build organizations across the target segments.
* Bring informed owner, developer, operator, management, construction, deployment, and lifecycle requirements into solution planning.
* Help Product Group teams understand segment-specific workflows, property or venue operating realities, procurement models, installation constraints, capital cycles, and lifecycle requirements.
* Connect Product Group leaders with the right business, operations, development, technology, and deployment stakeholders at priority organizations.
* Coordinate discovery sessions, advisory discussions, solution validation, pilot opportunities, and launch-readiness input as appropriate.
* Provide candid recommendations when proposed solutions, partnerships, or segment assumptions do not align with market realities.

**Marketing & Segment Strategy Collaboration**
----------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Marketing on segment strategy for MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.
* Contribute ecosystem intelligence to segment positioning, value propositions, messaging, content, campaigns, events, and thought leadership.
* Identify opportunities for partner stories, executive forums, relevant conferences, webinars, advisory councils, and market education.
* Help Marketing distinguish the ownership structures, operating models, buying processes, development cycles, capital plans, and influence patterns unique to each segment.
* Provide ongoing insight regarding investment activity, development and renovation trends, customer priorities, competitive moves, and partner-enabled routes to market.
* Use associations, conferences, and executive forums as channels for relationship development and market activation; this role does not own Calix's broader industry-organization or standards-body partnerships.

**Target Ecosystem Expertise**
==============================

Candidates should bring deep expertise and active relationships in at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with a second, and the ability to apply a common property-development and operating framework across all four segments.

**Multifamily / MDU**
---------------------

* Multifamily, planned-community, and build-to-rent developers, owners, operators, and property management organizations.
* Construction companies, general contractors, installation partners, low-voltage contractors, and smart-home integrators.
* Organizations responsible for property technology standards, deployment decisions, resident experience, capital planning, and building operations.
* Knowledge of how ownership, development, acquisition, redevelopment, property management, and construction stakeholders influence connectivity and managed-service decisions.

**Hospitality**
---------------

* Hotel brands and flags, including organizations such as Marriott, Hilton, IHG, and comparable companies that set technology standards or mandates.
* Hotel owners, ownership groups, and REITs, including organizations comparable to Host Hotels and Summit.
* Hotel management companies and operators, including organizations such as Aimbridge, Highgate, and comparable companies that operate properties and engage service providers.
* Hospitality developers, design-build participants, guest internet providers, in-room technology integrators, and organizations that influence new builds, renovations, property-improvement plans, conversions, deployment, and operations.

**Student Housing**
-------------------

* Student housing owners, operators, developers, and management companies, including organizations such as American Campus Communities, Greystar, The Preiss Company, Scion Group, and comparable companies.
* University housing departments and campus technology stakeholders that act as direct clients, operating stakeholders, or standards authorities.
* Public-private partnership organizations involved in developing and operating student housing.
* Construction, integration, access-control, and connectivity stakeholders supporting new development, renovations, high-density student communities, and annual turnover cycles.

**Venues**
----------

* Venue owners such as municipalities, school districts, colleges, private owners and developers, fairgrounds, cultural organizations, and comparable entities.
* Venue operators, promoters, tenant organizations, leagues, and event producers, including organizations such as VenuWorks, OVG360, ASM Global, and comparable companies.
* Architects, general contractors, low-voltage contractors, AV integrators, life-safety specialists, and other design-build participants.
* Organizations responsible for new venue development, renovation, connected venue systems, guest and staff operations, event-day reliability, sponsorship activation, and revenue-generating experiences.

**Property Lifecycle Coverage**
-------------------------------

* Influence technology and managed-service decisions across new development, acquisition and redevelopment, renovation and property-improvement planning, construction, installation, commissioning, property opening, ongoing operations, capital planning, and technology refresh cycles.
* Recognize when decision authority shifts among owners, developers, operators, brands, institutions, contractors, technology stakeholders, and service providers across the lifecycle.

**Market Intelligence & Internal Leadership**
=============================================

* Maintain a current, evidence-based view of priority organizations, decision-makers, market structures, development and renovation pipelines, capital plans, and operating trends in each segment.
* Translate relationships and market knowledge into clear decisions, recommendations, risks, and next actions for Calix leaders.
* Represent Calix at relevant real estate, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, property-technology, and managed-services forums where target stakeholders participate.
* Coordinate with the broader MSP ecosystem program so property relationships support MSP specialization and Managed Business objectives.
* Create partner dashboards, portfolio views, opportunity assessments, and executive updates that support disciplined relationship management.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, Hospitality Management, Urban Development, Marketing, Technology, Telecommunications, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem development, property partnerships, hospitality partnerships, venue partnerships, or a closely related function.
* Deep expertise and active relationships within at least one of the following ecosystems: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, or Venues; demonstrated familiarity with at least one additional segment is strongly preferred.
* An established network of executive, operating, development, technology, procurement, construction, and deployment relationships at relevant organizations serving one or more target segments.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and prioritize high-impact organizations rather than applying a broad, undifferentiated relationship-management approach.
* Proven success establishing strategic relationships, market-development initiatives, advisory programs, go-to-market collaborations, or ecosystem programs involving owners, developers, operators, management companies, builders, integrators, or adjacent organizations.
* Strong understanding of how ownership structures, property or venue operations, capital plans, development and renovation cycles, procurement practices, and technology standards influence buying decisions.
* Experience connecting end-market relationships to MSPs, managed network providers, systems integrators, VARs, or other indirect service-delivery partners.
* Experience working directly with Product Management or Product Group teams to shape requirements, validate solutions, or inform segment strategy.
* Experience collaborating with Marketing on vertical strategy, positioning, campaigns, events, executive engagement, or partner activation.
* Strong executive communication, relationship management, negotiation, judgment, and cross-functional influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct relationships with major developers, owners, operators, management companies, hotel brands, REITs, university housing organizations, venue operators, construction companies, architects, contractors, or integrators relevant to the four target segments.
* Expertise spanning more than one target segment, with the ability to recognize common buying patterns and segment-specific differences.
* Experience with managed Wi-Fi, broadband, networking, smart-building technology, PropTech, guest technology, campus technology, connected venues, or managed-services business models.
* Experience supporting solution validation, pilot programs, reference designs, strategic alliances, or market advisory initiatives.
* Credibility and active participation in relevant property, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, technology, or managed-services communities and conferences.
* MBA or related advanced degree.

Title: Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Manager
Description:
**Location:** Canada or United States (Remote / Hybrid; East Coast preferred, Greater Toronto Area a plus)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**About Adonis Partners**

At Adonis Partners, we exist to help our clients become more profitable — and their people more capable. We show up to do the real work, shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients, committed to creating lasting, measurable impact.

We are a fast-growing business excellence consultancy of 60 professionals across North America, serving over 30 clients annually.

We combine data-driven insights, deep industry experience, and lived leadership to cut through complexity and deliver results. Our team is built on a foundation of openness, humility, and relentless value creation. That’s how we’ve earned trust — and why clients call us back.

We partner most often with companies in:

* Food & Beverage Manufacturing
* Healthcare and Life Sciences
* Packaging
* Transportation, Logistics, and Supply Chain

Our clients are typically upper mid-market ($200M to $2B in revenue), including PE-backed companies undergoing operational transformation. Engagements range from 3–12 months, often involving immersive, on-site collaboration.

**Our Values (How We Work)**

* Genuine, Transparent & Fair – We tell the truth, even when it’s hard.
* Relentless in Creating Value – We own the outcome, no matter the obstacles.
* Always Getting Better – We seek feedback and grow through experience.
* Move Fast – We take action with urgency and accountability.
* Go the Extra Mile – We roll up our sleeves and do what it takes.

We live a service philosophy based on vulnerability, humility, and radical honesty. It’s not always comfortable, but it builds the kind of trust that lasts.

**Position Summary**

As the Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Specialist, you will own and deliver full-cycle recruitment for Adonis Partners across Canada and the United States. You will work closely with company leadership and practice leaders to understand current and upcoming client engagement needs, translate those needs into clear talent profiles, and identify high-calibre consultants and professionals who can deliver measurable results for our clients.

This role requires more than general recruiting experience. You will develop targeted talent pipelines across consulting, supply chain, procurement, operational excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and business transformation. You will recruit for both permanent and project-based needs, build relationships with experienced independent consultants, and help ensure Adonis Partners can respond quickly to client requirements while maintaining a high standard of candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities Recruitment Strategy & Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leadership and practice leads to understand business priorities, client demand, upcoming projects, and resource requirements.
* Clarify role requirements, including technical capabilities, industry experience, consulting experience, seniority, location, availability, travel expectations, and engagement duration.
* Develop practical sourcing and recruitment plans for permanent hires, contract professionals, and project-based consulting resources.
* Prioritize recruitment activities based on client timelines, business needs, and the availability of qualified talent.
* Provide market feedback on talent availability, candidate expectations, compensation ranges, and recruitment challenges across Canada and the United States.

**Consulting & Industry-Specific Talent Sourcing**

Identify and attract professionals across Adonis Partners’ core service areas, including:

* **Supply Chain & Procurement:** Supply Chain Transformation Consultants, Procurement Consultants, Strategic Sourcing Specialists, Category Management Professionals, S&OP and Planning Specialists, Inventory Optimization Experts, Logistics and Distribution Professionals, and Supplier Performance Specialists.
* **Operational & Business Excellence**: Lean Six Sigma practitioners (Green Belt, Black Belt, and Master Black Belt), Operational Excellence Consultants, Business Excellence Consultants, Continuous Improvement Leaders, Process Improvement Specialists, and Change Management Professionals.
* **Business & Transformation**: Management Consultants, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Program Managers, Business Systems Analysts, Data Analysts, and Business Intelligence Professionals.
* Assess candidates for the combination of functional expertise, industry knowledge, problem-solving ability, communication, facilitation, and client-facing skills required in consulting environments.
* Recognize the difference between candidates with operational experience and practitioners who have successfully led or delivered transformation and improvement initiatives.

**Full-Cycle Recruitment & Candidate Assessment**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, sourcing, resume screening, introductory calls, structured interviews, candidate shortlisting, interview coordination, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff.
* Conduct initial candidate interviews to assess experience, consulting capabilities, project examples, communication skills, motivation, compensation expectations, location, and availability.
* Evaluate candidates against role-specific criteria and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations to hiring stakeholders.
* Coordinate technical, functional, and leadership interviews with practice leaders and other interviewers.
* Maintain timely and professional communication with candidates throughout the process, including feedback and status updates.
* Support offer discussions and closing activities while ensuring candidate expectations are aligned with the role and engagement requirements.

**Canada & United States Talent Acquisition**

* Build and maintain active talent pipelines across Canadian and US markets for current and anticipated hiring needs.
* Use LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, job boards, industry groups, and other sourcing channels to identify qualified candidates.
* Develop an understanding of regional talent markets, role availability, compensation expectations, and relevant employment practices.
* Confirm candidate location, work authorization status, willingness to travel, and availability for the relevant role or client assignment.
* Coordinate with leadership and appropriate internal or external resources when cross-border work authorization or employment considerations require review; do not provide legal or immigration advice.
* Adapt sourcing strategies to support remote, hybrid, and client-site assignments across North America.

**Talent Pipeline & Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain a searchable network of qualified consultants and professionals, including independent consultants and contract talent.
* Maintain accurate candidate profiles covering skills, industry experience, project history, certifications, location, availability, compensation expectations, and engagement preferences.
* Build long-term relationships with high-potential candidates, including individuals who may not be suitable for an immediate opening but could fit future engagements.
* Create talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill capabilities, particularly in procurement, supply chain, operational excellence, and Lean Six Sigma.
* Re-engage previously screened or placed candidates as new client requirements arise.

**Recruitment Operations, Systems & Reporting**

* Maintain complete and accurate candidate and recruitment records in Salesforce or the company’s designated recruitment tracking system.
* Track each recruitment requirement from intake through placement, including sourcing activity, candidate status, interview feedback, decisions, and outcomes.
* Prepare regular recruitment pipeline updates for leadership, highlighting progress, bottlenecks, risks, and support required.
* Monitor recruitment metrics such as time to shortlist, time to fill, qualified candidates presented, interview conversion, offer acceptance, and successful placements.
* Develop and improve standardized job descriptions, interview guides, candidate scorecards, recruitment workflows, and reporting templates.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle candidate information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**Qualifications Required**

Title: Vice President Safety
Description:
**Pay Rate:**

$170,000 - $200,000/year

**Position Summary**

The Vice President, Safety serves as the company's senior subject-matter leader and executive advisor on occupational safety, health, regulatory compliance, and loss prevention. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role develops and executes a comprehensive, company-wide safety strategy aligned with organizational objectives and the unique risks associated with low voltage and specialty contracting operations. The Vice President, Safety leads the company's Safety leadership team, provides executive oversight of safety programs, incident management, training, and performance reporting, and partners with operational leaders to build a culture in which safety is incorporated into business decisions at every level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive, company-wide safety strategy aligned with organizational objectives, operational priorities, and the unique risks associated with low voltage and specialty contracting operations.
* Serve as the company's senior subject-matter leader and executive advisor on occupational safety, health, regulatory compliance, and loss prevention.
* Establish enterprise-wide safety goals, performance expectations, leading and lagging indicators, and accountability standards.
* Provide executive leadership with regular assessments of safety performance, significant incidents, emerging risks, regulatory developments, and recommended actions.
* Partner with operational leaders to ensure safety is incorporated into business decisions rather than functioning as a separate compliance activity.
* Build and sustain a culture in which leaders at every level understand their responsibility and accountability for safe operations.

**Safety Programs & Risk Management**

* Provide executive oversight of the company's safety and loss-control programs, policies, procedures, and management systems.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with applicable OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E, client requirements, and federal, state, and local regulations.
* Establish consistent company-wide standards for hazard identification, jobsite safety, electrical safety, fall protection, ladder safety, personal protective equipment, fleet and driver safety, and other risks applicable to company operations.
* Evaluate emerging operational risks and ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into policies, training, project planning, and field execution.
* Partner with Risk Management, insurance carriers, brokers, and operational leadership to reduce the frequency and severity of workplace injuries, vehicle incidents, property losses, and other safety-related exposures.
* Provide executive oversight of drug and alcohol testing programs, including pre-employment, random, reasonable-suspicion, post-accident, and other testing required by company policy or applicable regulations.

**Incident Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish standards for reporting, investigating, documenting, and responding to injuries, incidents, near misses, vehicle accidents, and significant safety events.
* Provide executive oversight of serious incident and root-cause investigations, ensuring corrective and preventive actions address systemic issues rather than individual events alone.
* Review incident trends and leading indicators to identify recurring hazards, operational weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure significant corrective actions are assigned, tracked, validated, and closed.
* Partner with Operations and Human Resources on return-to-work and restricted-duty strategies following workplace injuries.

**Field Operations & Project Safety**

* Establish expectations and standards for field audits, inspections, observations, and project safety reviews across company operations.
* Ensure Safety leadership maintains a visible field presence and develops strong working relationships with field employees, supervisors, project managers, and operational leaders.
* Provide oversight of project-specific safety plans and requirements for complex, high-risk, or strategic projects.
* Participate in or assign appropriate Safety leadership to preconstruction, pre-bid, project-startup, and client safety meetings.
* Evaluate customer and general-contractor safety requirements and work with Operations to address requirements that create significant operational, contractual, or financial risk.
* Ensure lessons learned from field observations and incidents are translated into improvements across the organization.

**Training & Safety Culture**

* Establish the company's safety training strategy and minimum training requirements by position and level of responsibility.
* Oversee the development and effectiveness of safety orientation, toolbox talks, supervisor training, regulatory training, and continuing education programs.
* Ensure required certifications and regulatory training are appropriately tracked and maintained.
* Develop leadership capability among managers and supervisors so that safety ownership resides with Operations as well as the Safety organization.
* Lead initiatives that increase employee engagement, hazard reporting, near-miss reporting, and proactive identification of unsafe conditions.
* Chair or provide executive sponsorship for the company Safety Committee and other safety-related leadership forums.

**Performance Measurement & Executive Reporting**

* Establish and monitor meaningful safety performance metrics, including leading indicators as well as traditional lagging measures.
* Provide monthly, quarterly, and annual safety reporting and analysis to executive leadership.
* Monitor trends involving recordable incidents, lost-time injuries, severity, vehicle incidents, near misses, corrective actions, training completion, inspections, and other relevant measures.
* Use safety data to establish priorities and direct company resources toward areas of greatest risk.
* Benchmark company performance against relevant industry trends, insurance data, customer expectations, and organizational goals.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the company's Safety leadership team, including Safety Directors, Managers, Leads, and Specialists as applicable.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, territories, reporting structures, and performance expectations throughout the Safety organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing safety professionals capable of partnering effectively with field and operational leadership.
* Assess organizational staffing needs based on company growth, project locations, customer requirements, and operational risk.
* Build succession plans and develop future Safety leaders.

**External & Regulatory Relationships**

* Serve as a senior company representative, as appropriate, with OSHA and other regulatory agencies, insurance carriers, brokers, customers, general contractors, trade associations, and other external stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory changes and emerging industry practices and determine their implications for company operations.
* Support major customer qualification processes, audits, and requests involving company safety performance and programs.
* Represent the company's safety philosophy and capabilities during strategic customer discussions, major project pursuits, and other executive-level engagements.

**Budget & Administration**

* Develop, manage, and monitor the annual Safety department budget.
* Evaluate investments in training, technology, PPE, equipment, outside consultants, and other safety resources based on organizational risk and business need.

* Maintain executive oversight of the corporate safety manual and ensure policies and programs remain current, practical, and aligned with company operations.
* Evaluate safety management technology and reporting systems to improve visibility, accountability, trend analysis, and field adoption.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected for this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The company reserves the right to modify job duties at any time based on business needs.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Safety Management, Environmental Health and Safety, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and executive-level experience.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible safety experience, preferably within electrical, low voltage, specialty contracting, construction, or similarly distributed field operations.
* 5+ years of senior safety leadership experience with responsibility for multiple locations, regions, business units, or a geographically dispersed workforce.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing professional safety teams.
* Extensive working knowledge of OSHA regulations and construction-industry safety practices.
* Strong knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical workplace safety requirements relevant to company operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading serious incident investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective-action programs, and organizational learning.
* Experience developing and presenting safety performance information and risk recommendations to executive leadership.

* Influence: Builds commitment to safe work practices through relationships, credibility, coaching, and accountability.
* Accountability: Establishes clear expectations and follows through when performance does not meet company standards.
* Data-driven decision making: Uses incident data, observations, trends, and leading indicators to establish priorities and allocate resources.

Title: Head of Sales, North America — Agentis Asset Management Services

Asset Management Services (“AMS”) is the asset management practice of Agentis Capital Advisors, a global infrastructure advisory and investment platform. AMS manages more than 120 infrastructure assets representing over $35bn in enterprise value across renewables, public-private partnerships, digital and social infrastructure. We support our clients over the life of their assets through four service pillars:

* Financial Model Management – We build, standardize, enhance and maintain the financial models behind our clients’ funds and portfolio companies
* Financial Services Management – We run the accounting, budgeting, lender compliance and financial reporting for project companies
* Operations Management – We oversee the day-to-day management of assets, including contract administration, performance monitoring, and board and stakeholder support
* Fund Operations & Reporting – We maintain the fund-level valuation models, NAV and exit calculations, and leadership and LP reporting

AMS gives private markets and infrastructure investors one consistent, auditable and trusted view of their portfolios, delivered as a managed service. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, developers and project companies. Our guiding principles of excellence, client success, commitment, people and entrepreneurship set us apart.

**The Opportunity**

Private-markets managers and large asset owners run their portfolios on hundreds of inconsistent models, built by different advisors in different formats. Valuation, investor reporting and portfolio oversight are slow, manual and hard to audit. AMS solves this. We take over a client’s portfolio models, rebuild them to one standard on our technology-enabled platform, and deliver a live, fund-level view of the whole portfolio. We maintain and enhance it with our specialists on an ongoing basis.

We are looking for a Head of Sales, North America to take this service to market and expand our client base. This is a hands-on, player-coach role, reporting to the Agentis Capital Managing Partners.

* The opportunity to hire and lead additional sales professionals as the business grows
* An entrepreneurial culture with a flat structure and direct access to Partners and senior leadership, where good ideas are acted on quickly

* Expand existing clients from an initial portfolio into wider fund, valuation and reporting work

* Help develop sales collateral, case studies, demonstrations and the website, using the platform’s outputs as proof points
* Represent AMS at industry conferences and events across North America, and build the service’s profile in the market
* Track competitors and adjacent offerings, and report what is winning and losing deals

**Build the Sales Team**

**Partner with Delivery**

* Ensure a smooth handover from sale to delivery during onboarding, set realistic client expectations and support client change management
* Report weekly to the Partners and AMS steering group on pipeline, conversion, forecast and market feedback

**Skills and Experience**

* Experience selling fund administration, fund accounting, back-office, valuation, portfolio-monitoring, investor-reporting or financial-data solutions to private-markets managers is strongly preferred

* A working understanding of how funds and portfolio companies are valued, modelled and reported
* An existing network of finance and asset management leaders at North American private-markets managers, pension funds or asset owners is a strong asset

* Self-motivated and entrepreneurial: comfortable building process, collateral and pipeline from scratch in a start-up setting within an established firm
* Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills
* Infrastructure, renewables or real-assets experience is an asset

* Comprehensive benefits, including extended health care

* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.
* Approve the estimate only when unresolved items are quantified, allocated to a named owner and covered through contingency, qualification, variation entitlement or management-approved risk acceptance.
  

  

#### **Commercial Competitiveness and Vendor/OEM Management**

  
  

* Create a competitive solution and pricing strategy from the first submission, normally including a fully compliant base option and an AFT-designed value-engineered alternative where the tender permits.
* Build and manage principal, OEM, distributor and specialist-partner relationships; secure registrations, certifications, rebates, project discounts, price validity, lead-time commitments, and technical support early in the cycle.
  

  

#### **Proposal Quality and Submission Control**

  
  

* Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, persuasive and aligned with RFP format, technical and commercial separation, required certificates, datasheets, drawings, compliance matrices and submission instructions.
* Enforce a two-level review for major bids: preparer/LOB review followed by independent cross-check and Head of Pre-Sales sign-off.
* Ensure timely submission of all tenders across UAE, KSA and Qatar, with documented exceptions and recovery actions.
  

  

#### **Service, AMC and Casual-Job Costing**

  
  

* Ensure Pre-Sales is the single point of accountability for service-proposal solution design, BOQ, vendor quotations and costing completeness before customer submission.
* Use Finance-approved loaded man-hour rates and validate service frequency, response/resolution commitments, standby/on-call requirements, vehicles, tools, spares, subcontract support, escalation, warranty overlap and contract duration.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Strategic leadership and decision-making skills with a focus on competitiveness and risk management.

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

### **Job Summary**

Versa Networks is seeking an accomplished, highly motivated Director of Channel Sales – Canada to drive the expansion of our Service Provider, Managed Service Provider (MSP), and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) business across the Canadian market.

This is a strategic, revenue-generating role responsible for developing and expanding relationships with Canada's leading Tier 1 telecommunications providers, including Rogers Communications and Bell Canada, while identifying, recruiting, and enabling high-potential MSP and MSSP partners throughout the country.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable partner ecosystem, driving adoption of Versa's networking and cybersecurity solutions, and generating sustainable recurring revenue through partner-led go-to-market strategies.

This position requires an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader with strong executive relationship skills, deep knowledge of the Canadian telecommunications and managed services landscape, and a demonstrated track record of developing new business.

The role is remote and must be based in Eastern Canada, preferably within Ontario or Quebec, to facilitate engagement with strategic partners and their leadership teams

### **Responsibilities**

Strategic Service Provider Account Development

* Own and execute Versa's channel sales strategy for Canada's Tier 1 telecommunications and service provider market, with particular emphasis on Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, and other strategic providers.
* Establish and expand executive-level relationships across partner product management, managed services, cybersecurity, network engineering, sales, and business development organizations.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Versa's SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, and security technologies into partners' managed networking and cybersecurity portfolios.
* Develop joint business plans, technology roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies with strategic service provider partners.
* Navigate complex partner organizations, commercial negotiations, procurement processes, and long-term technology evaluations.
* Drive strategic agreements and commercial commitments that create sustainable recurring revenue for Versa.

MSP & MSSP Ecosystem Development

* Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential MSP and MSSP partners across Canada.
* Prioritize partners with established enterprise and midmarket customer bases and the ability to deliver managed networking and security services.
* Develop relationships with partner executive leadership, sales organizations, and technical decision-makers.
* Build and execute partner business plans with defined revenue targets, pipeline commitments, and joint sales activities.
* Drive partner onboarding, technical enablement, sales readiness, and go-to-market execution.
* Expand existing partner relationships through additional Versa solutions and new managed service offerings.
* Establish a scalable and productive partner ecosystem focused on measurable revenue contribution.

Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management

* Own and deliver assigned annual bookings and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for the Canadian Service Provider, MSP, and MSSP business.
* Proactively generate new business opportunities through strategic partner development and joint selling.
* Build, maintain, and accurately forecast a qualified pipeline of partner-led opportunities.
* Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue enterprise and midmarket customer opportunities.
* Drive opportunities through technical validation, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
* Establish measurable quarterly business objectives and conduct regular partner business reviews.
* Maintain strong accountability for pipeline conversion, partner productivity, and recurring revenue growth.

Solution Positioning & Go-to-Market Execution Position Versa's integrated networking and cybersecurity portfolio, including:

* Networking Solutions
* + Secure SD-WAN and Advanced SD-WAN
  + Software-Defined LAN (SD-LAN)
  + Secure routing and network transformation
  + Branch and distributed enterprise connectivity
  + Network segmentation and infrastructure modernization
* Cybersecurity Solutions
* + Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
  + Security Service Edge (SSE)
  + Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
  + Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
  + Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
  + Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW)
  + DNS Security and Filtering
  + Advanced Threat Protection and Data Loss Prevention
* Translate these capabilities into compelling managed service offerings that help partners differentiate, increase recurring revenue, improve customer retention, and expand their addressable markets.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Versa's North American Service Provider leadership, solution engineering, product management, marketing, and customer success organizations.
* Coordinate executive engagement and strategic partner initiatives with Versa's senior leadership.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support partner technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and solution launches.
* Partner with channel marketing to develop joint campaigns, partner events, demand-generation initiatives, and sales enablement programs.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to influence Versa's Canadian go-to-market strategy.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, channel sales, telecommunications, networking, or cybersecurity.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working with Service Providers, MSPs, MSSPs, or managed services organizations.
* Demonstrated success developing strategic partnerships and generating net-new revenue through indirect sales channels.
* Established relationships within the Canadian telecommunications, MSP, or MSSP ecosystem, preferably including Rogers, Bell Canada, or other major service providers.
* Strong understanding of SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, Zero Trust, and enterprise cybersecurity architectures.
* Proven experience developing partner business plans, building qualified pipelines, and exceeding sales quotas.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior executives, product leaders, technical stakeholders, and partner sales teams.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles, commercial negotiations, and strategic partner agreements.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment.
* Must reside in Eastern Canada and be willing to travel regularly throughout Canada and occasionally to the United States.
* Preferred Qualifications

  + Bilingual proficiency in English and French is an asset, particularly for engagement with Quebec-based partners.

Title: Senior Trackwork Interface Engineer
Description:
Req ID:535092

From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. **Your Future Role**
--------------------

Take on a new challenge and apply your railway engineering, interface management, and project delivery expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You'll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a key role in shaping the **Riyadh Metro Line 2 Extension** by supporting the coordination, integration, and delivery of trackwork and 750V DC third rail systems. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with teams across the business (Civil, Traction Power, Signaling, Rolling Stock, Systems Integration, and Construction), manage technical interfaces between disciplines, coordinate engineering activities, monitor project deliverables, support risk and change management processes, and provide technical support during construction and commissioning activities.

### **We'll look to you for:**

* Managing and coordinating interfaces between Trackwork with Civil, Traction Power, Signaling, Rolling Stock, Telecommunications, and Systems Integration disciplines.

* Supporting the development, review, and implementation of trackwork and third rail engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

* Maintaining interface registers, action trackers, technical queries, and coordination logs to ensure alignment between stakeholders.

* Monitoring design progress, engineering deliverables, and design changes to ensure compliance with project requirements and schedules.

* Identifying, assessing, and resolving technical interface issues and supporting risk mitigation activities.

* Coordinating multidisciplinary design reviews, workshops, interface meetings, and technical discussions with clients, consultants, contractors, and approval authorities.

* Reviewing engineering submissions and deliverables to verify consistency, constructability, and compliance with project specifications, standards, and interface requirements.

* Supporting project managers with engineering planning, reporting, progress monitoring, risk management, and stakeholder coordination activities.

* Ensuring effective communication and integration between design, construction, testing, commissioning, and operational teams.

* Supporting field activities during construction, testing, commissioning, and handover phases, including resolution of interface-related technical issues.

* Assisting in the preparation of engineering reports, interface agreements, risk assessments, design review comments, technical presentations, and project documentation.

**All About You**
-----------------

We value passion and attitude over experience. That's why we don't expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we've listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Degree in Engineering, Railway Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Experience in railway infrastructure, metro projects, trackwork systems, or multidisciplinary engineering environments.

* Strong understanding of trackwork systems, slab track construction, rail interfaces, and 750V DC third rail systems.

* Proven experience in interface management, design coordination, systems integration, or multidisciplinary project delivery.

* Knowledge of railway project lifecycle phases including design, construction, testing & commissioning, and handover.

* Familiarity with interface management processes, change control, configuration management, and technical governance procedures.

* Understanding of railway standards and specifications including EN, IEC, AREMA, UIC, and client-specific requirements.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines.

* Experience supporting engineering planning, progress reporting, risk management, and project controls activities.

* Ability to identify, manage, and resolve technical interface issues in complex railway projects.

* Experience coordinating contractors, consultants, clients, and external authorities within large infrastructure projects.

* Knowledge of engineering document management systems, technical submissions, and approval workflows.

* A proactive and collaborative mindset with strong problem-solving, leadership, and coordination capabilities.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP

### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

Title: FACILITIES MAINTENANCE & CONTRACTOR SAFETY OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Facilities Maintenance & Contractor Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of facility maintenance activities while managing contractor safety performance across the organization. The role focuses on maintaining a safe work environment, ensuring compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of maintenance and facility management services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.

* Develop, implement, and enforce contractor safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct contractor pre-qualification assessments to evaluate safety performance, certifications, and compliance records.
* Review and approve Permit-to-Work (PTW) documentation, risk assessments, and method statements before work commences.
