Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.

* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.

The Back Office (BO) eMBMS Engineer supports the availability, performance, and service continuity of the LTE Broadcast / evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service platform used for mission-critical communications. The engineer owns second-line operational investigation and restoration of the Ericsson Mission Critical Broadcast Delivery Center (MC BDC) / Broadcast Core, and works across MCX application servers, LTE RAN, IP transport, cloud infrastructure, and network management teams to resolve end-to-end service issues.

This is an operations and service-assurance position, not sole ownership of RAN radio design, transport routing, MCX application logic, or cloud infrastructure. The engineer should understand those domains well enough to isolate faults, coordinate restoration, and validate outcomes.

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.

* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.

Title: Production Driver
Description:
**Production Driver**

**Department:** Roasting & Production / Catering

**Reports To (Primary Manager):** General Manager, Warehouse Operations, Supply Stream & Logistics

**Catering Operational Direction:** Catering Logistics Manager and Catering Logistics Assistant Manager

**Direct Reports:** None

**Location:** Long Island City, NY (Primary Work Location)

**Service Area:** New York City and surrounding areas

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Production Driver plays an essential role in supporting Joe Coffee Company's Roasting & Production and Catering departments through safe, reliable transportation, delivery, and logistics support. This cross-departmental position is primarily responsible for transporting coffee products, supplies, and equipment between Joe Coffee facilities, off-site storage locations, catering venues, and other designated delivery destinations.

In addition to driving and delivery responsibilities, this position supports catering event preparation, equipment handling, warehouse organization, and occasional production activities as needed. The Production Driver works closely with both departments to ensure that products and equipment arrive safely, accurately, and on time.

While this position supports multiple departments, the General Manager, Warehouse Operations, Supply Stream & Logistics serves as the employee's primary manager and maintains overall supervisory responsibility.

As a representative of Joe Coffee both on the road and at delivery locations, the Production Driver is expected to demonstrate professionalism, accountability, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety, teamwork, and enlightened hospitality.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Driving & Delivery**

* Safely operate company vehicles to transport coffee products, supplies, and equipment between the Long Island City Roastery, Catering Warehouse, off-site storage facilities, catering venues, and other designated locations
* Execute assigned delivery and pickup routes in accordance with daily schedules and departmental priorities
* Communicate arrival times, departures, delays, and route changes to the appropriate department leadership
* Load, secure, transport, and unload products and equipment using appropriate handling procedures to prevent damage or injury
* Verify the accuracy of deliveries and pickups, including product quantities, equipment, and required documentation
* Complete and retain delivery records, including invoices, signatures, and photographs when applicable
* Safely operate vehicle equipment, including liftgates and other loading or unloading mechanisms
* Conduct routine vehicle inspections and promptly report maintenance needs, damage, safety concerns, or cleanliness issues to management
* Coordinate and complete scheduled vehicle maintenance at designated leasing or service facilities
* Follow all applicable traffic laws, parking regulations, and company vehicle policies
* Immediately report vehicle accidents, collisions, damage, or safety incidents to management and notify the appropriate authorities as required
* Represent Joe Coffee professionally and courteously while interacting with coworkers, customers, vendors, venue contacts, and members of the public

### **Roastery & Warehouse Logistics**

* Transport products and materials between the Long Island City Roastery, off-site storage locations, and other designated facilities
* Support receiving, inventory organization, storage, and distribution of coffee products and operational supplies
* Assist with loading and unloading deliveries and maintaining accurate receiving documentation
* Coordinate with Roastery Leadership to ensure timely movement of products and materials.
* Maintain organized and accessible storage areas to support safe and efficient warehouse operations
* Assist with basic production and packaging activities as needed, including learning to operate packaging equipment such as weigh-and-fill machines, heat sealers, and scales
* Develop familiarity with production workflows to provide occasional operational support when business needs require it

### **Catering Logistics & Event Production**

* Support the preparation, packing, transportation, delivery, and return of equipment and supplies for catering events
* Pack event materials and equipment in accordance with established Bin | Best Practices to ensure accuracy, organization, and safe transportation
* Unpack, inspect, and return equipment and supplies following established Catering Warehouse SOP standards
* Safely handle, load, secure, and transport sensitive, high-value catering equipment, including professional espresso machines valued at $6,000 or more
* Deliver equipment, products, and supplies directly to event baristas, venue contacts, or designated representatives
* Verify delivery contents and communicate any missing, damaged, or incorrect items to Catering Leadership
* Support timely equipment returns, inventory reconciliation, and preparation for upcoming events
* Collaborate with the Catering Logistics Manager, Catering Logistics Assistant Manager, Catering Operations Manager, and Catering Event Producer to support event execution and logistical needs
* Maintain a professional, hospitality-driven presence when representing Joe Coffee at catering events and client locations

### **Vehicle, Equipment & Workplace Safety**

* Follow established warehouse, vehicle, and equipment safety procedures
* Participate in required warehouse safety training and annual defensive driving refresher courses
* Use appropriate lifting, carrying, loading, and material-handling techniques to minimize the risk of injury or equipment damage
* Properly secure equipment and products during transportation, particularly fragile or high-value items
* Identify and promptly communicate unsafe conditions, equipment malfunctions, vehicle damage, and potential hazards to management
* Maintain compliance with applicable food safety, workplace safety, and operational standards
* Keep company vehicles, loading areas, and warehouse spaces clean, safe, and organized

### **Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Operational Efficiency**

* Coordinate with Roasting & Production and Catering Leadership to prioritize daily transportation and logistics needs
* Adapt to changing schedules, delivery requirements, and departmental priorities
* Communicate proactively to ensure smooth transitions between departments and timely completion of assignments
* Maintain accurate records and documentation related to deliveries, equipment, and inventory
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation workflows, organization, and operational efficiency
* Perform other related duties as assigned to support the evolving needs of both departments and the business

**Departmental Reporting & Collaboration**
------------------------------------------

The Production Driver is a cross-departmental position supporting both Roasting & Production and Catering. While responsibilities and daily assignments may vary between departments, the General Manager, Warehouse Operations, Supply Stream & Logistics remains the employee's primary manager and is responsible for overall supervision, performance management, scheduling oversight, and employment-related matters.

**Roasting & Production:** The Production Driver works under the direction of the General Manager, Warehouse Operations, Supply Stream & Logistics and collaborates with Roastery Leadership to coordinate deliveries, inventory movement, and operational priorities.

**Catering:** When assigned to Catering, the Production Driver receives day-to-day operational direction from the Catering Logistics Manager, with additional guidance from the Catering Logistics Assistant Manager. The employee also collaborates closely with the Catering Operations Manager and Catering Event Producer to support event preparation, delivery schedules, and logistics execution.

Catering Leadership is responsible for directing and coordinating Catering-specific assignments, while the General Manager, Warehouse Operations, Supply Stream & Logistics retains primary managerial oversight. Both departments are expected to communicate and coordinate priorities to ensure clear expectations, balanced workloads, and effective cross-departmental support.

**Joe Coffee Values & Cultural Expectations**
---------------------------------------------

**Curiosity**

* Demonstrates a willingness to learn new processes, equipment, and operational practices
* Contributes ideas and participates in collaborative problem-solving to improve team performance

**Community**

* Practices enlightened hospitality through respectful, thoughtful, and supportive interactions with coworkers, vendors, and customers
* Recognizes the importance of teamwork and the role of logistics in supporting Joe Coffee's broader community

**Commitment**

* Demonstrates reliability, accountability, and attention to detail in completing assigned responsibilities
* Prioritizes safety, accuracy, and timely execution to support the success of Joe Coffee and its customers

**Craft**

* Understands the importance of proper handling, packaging, and transportation in maintaining the quality and integrity of Joe Coffee products and equipment
* Takes pride in delivering consistent, high-quality work

### **Additional Cultural Expectations**

All employees are expected to uphold Joe Coffee's Code of Conduct and contribute to a workplace built on mutual respect, collaboration, and open communication.

* Respect the time, contributions, and experiences of others
* Foster a supportive environment focused on growth, learning, and shared success
* Communicate with positive intent and professionalism
* Take ownership of individual responsibilities while supporting collective team goals
* Demonstrate flexibility and a willingness to assist teammates when business needs require it

**Minimum Qualifications**

### **Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* Experience driving in New York City and navigating urban traffic conditions
* Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively across departments
* Ability to safely handle and transport fragile, heavy, or high-value equipment
* Ability to read and interpret invoices, delivery documentation, schedules, and basic inventory records
* Basic familiarity with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office preferred but not required
* Previous experience in delivery, logistics, warehouse operations, or event production preferred
* Prior safety or operational training, including forklift safety, OSHA-related practices, or HACCP, preferred but not required
* Ability to communicate effectively in English to understand safety instructions, delivery requirements, and operational documentation

### **Driver Eligibility Requirements**

All employees who operate company vehicles must meet and maintain Joe Coffee Company's Driver Eligibility Requirements as a condition of performing driving responsibilities.

**Eligible drivers must:**

* Possess a valid driver's license
* Have at least two (2) years of driving experience, excluding driving experience obtained outside the United States (experience driving in NYC preferred)
* Successfully complete a pre-employment driving background check, including a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) review
* Maintain an acceptable driving record as defined below
* Meet applicable company vehicle insurance and safety requirements

**Acceptable Driving Record**

Drivers must meet the following standards:

* No major driving violations within the past three (3) years
* No more than one (1) at-fault accident within the past three (3) years
* No more than three (3) minor moving violations within the past two (2) years

**Major Driving Violations**

Major violations include:

* Drug- or alcohol-related violations involving the operation of a motor vehicle
* Vehicular homicide, manslaughter, or use of a motor vehicle in the commission of a felony
* Hit-and-run offenses
* Reckless driving
* Speeding 20 MPH or more above the posted speed limit
* Speed contests, drag racing, or attempting to evade law enforcement

**Minor Driving Violations**

Minor violations include moving traffic citations that do not qualify as major violations, such as:

* Speeding less than 20 MPH above the posted speed limit
* Failure to stop or yield
* Improper lane changes
* Other moving traffic violations

The following are not classified as moving violations for purposes of this policy:

* Violations involving vehicle equipment, load, or size requirements
* Improper display or failure to display license plates
* Failure to sign or display a vehicle registration card

**Ongoing Driver Eligibility**

Employees must maintain driving eligibility throughout their employment in positions requiring vehicle operation. Drivers must promptly notify management of any license suspension, revocation, traffic citation, accident, or other circumstance that may affect their eligibility.

Joe Coffee reserves the right to conduct periodic driving record reviews in accordance with applicable law and company policy. Failure to maintain driver eligibility may result in removal of driving responsibilities and further employment action, as appropriate.

### **Physical & Environmental Requirements**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive movements throughout a shift
* Ability to load, unload, and move products and equipment using appropriate material-handling tools and safe lifting practices
* Ability to work in warehouse, production, and event environments that may not be climate-controlled
* Ability to safely enter and exit delivery vehicles and operate associated loading equipment
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation

**90-Day Introductory Period**
------------------------------

All new employees are subject to a 90-day introductory period beginning on their first day of employment. During this period, Joe Coffee will evaluate job performance, attendance, reliability, adherence to company policies, and overall ability to meet the expectations of the role. Successful completion of the introductory period does not guarantee continued employment or alter the at-will nature of the employment relationship.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations associated with this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Responsibilities may evolve based on operational needs, and employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.

Joe Coffee Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

Nothing in this job description constitutes an employment contract or modifies the at-will employment relationship

Title: Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist

The Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist, a part of the Digital Security Group, is a senior hands-on practitioner responsible for proactive threat hunting, digital forensics, incident investigation, authorized penetration testing, adversary simulation and security-control validation across KPMG’s enterprise environment. This role reports to the Director of Security Operations.

The successful candidate will independently investigate complex security incidents, reconstruct attack paths, determine scope and root cause, preserve evidence, and guide containment, eradication and recovery. The role combines advanced Windows and cloud forensics with attacker tradecraft and offensive-security expertise.

This individual will reproduce attacks in approved environments, convert evidence into defensible conclusions, and strengthen prevention, detection and response through actionable findings, improved detections and remediation validation.

What you will do:

The Senior Threat Hunter & DFIR Specialist leads complex investigations, proactive threat hunting, and authorized adversary testing across endpoint, identity, network, application, Microsoft 365, Azure, and hybrid-cloud environments.

* Lead high-severity incident investigations through evidence preservation, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis, reconstructing attack timelines and identifying compromised systems, identities, persistence, lateral movement, and potential data exfiltration
* Collect and analyze endpoint, disk, memory, cloud, identity, application, and network evidence, including Windows and Linux forensics, while maintaining forensic integrity and chain of custody
* Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts using Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, and enterprise telemetry to identify malicious activity and emerging threats
* Translate investigation and hunting findings into IOCs, MITRE ATT&CK mappings, improved detections, logging requirements, and response playbooks
* Conduct authorized penetration testing, red-team, and purple-team exercises across applications, APIs, networks, identity platforms, and cloud environments to identify and validate attack paths and assess security controls

* Deliver clear technical reports, leadership briefings, and prioritized remediation recommendations, while providing technical direction and mentorship to analysts during investigations and threat hunts

This position may require on-call and after-hours work, as needed to support KPMG business needs.

What you bring to this role:

* 2+ years of relevant cybersecurity or enterprise IT experience, with hands-on experience in threat hunting, DFIR, incident response, security operations, penetration testing, or red teaming
* Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, endpoint security, SIEM/EDR, identity, networking, cloud security, and attacker tradecraft, including MITRE ATT&CK
* Advanced Windows forensics knowledge and working knowledge of Linux forensics, with the ability to independently investigate compromises and reconstruct attack chains from forensic evidence
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Sentinel, KQL, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Azure security telemetry
* Experience with forensic and endpoint triage tools such as KAPE or Velociraptor, including the collection and analysis of disk, memory, VM, and cloud evidence
* Experience with penetration testing and adversary emulation across applications, APIs, networks, identity, and cloud environments, using tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Impacket, NetExec, or Wireshark

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.
  + Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

* Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

  + Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections
  + Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections
  + Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  + Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

  

**Continuous Education**

* Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

  + Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)
  + Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  + Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions
  + Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.
  + The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

  

**Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems**

  + Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  + Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  + Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.

Title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
Description:
**Req ID:** 397949
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).
  
Job Description
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS
  
  
**Company:** NTT DATA
  
**Delivery Model:** Offshore
  
**Tower:** Application Infrastructure Services
  
**Capability:** Oracle Analytics Middleware
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Experience Required:** 10+ Years
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking an experienced Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS to provide technical leadership and hands-on production support for enterprise Oracle Analytics environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical SME responsible for the architecture, administration, availability, performance, security, patching, modernization, and operational support of Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE/OBI), Oracle Fusion Middleware, WebLogic, Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Linux-hosted Oracle analytics platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical architecture role requiring the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex production issues spanning the analytics, middleware, operating system, database, identity, security, and application layers.
  
  
The Technical Architect will also provide leadership for platform modernization, OBIEE-to-OAS migrations, major upgrades, patching, performance optimization, automation, disaster recovery, and environment lifecycle management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Oracle Analytics – OAS OBIEE
  
  
Provide architecture, administration, engineering, and production support for Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) and OBIEE/OBI environments.
  
  
Administer and troubleshoot Oracle Analytics services, configurations, repositories, catalogs, agents, scheduled jobs, caches, and usage tracking.
  
  
Monitor and troubleshoot report execution, dashboards, analytics services, and platform components.
  
  
Perform detailed log analysis and correlation across Oracle Analytics and associated middleware components.
  
  
Diagnose platform outages and execute appropriate service-restoration and recovery procedures.
  
  
Manage analytics repositories, catalogs, BAR files, RPDs, deployments, and environment-specific configurations.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex report, dashboard, semantic-model, repository, and data-access issues.
  
  
Monitor platform health, capacity, availability, and performance.
  
  
Provide technical guidance for analytics platform upgrades, modernization, migrations, and decommissioning.
  
  
Oracle Fusion Middleware WebLogic
  
  
Administer and support Oracle Fusion Middleware and Oracle WebLogic Server environments.
  
  
Manage WebLogic domains, Administration Servers, Managed Servers, Node Manager, clusters, and associated services.

Title: Claims Officer
Description:
**\*\*\*PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO QATARI CANDIDATES\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.

Duties & Responsibilities:

* **Internal Audit Planning:** Engage in the planning and conduct of internal audits encompassing all functions and elements necessary to confirm compliance with applicable Canadian regulations and approved manuals.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.

* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* Post-secondary education in an aviation related field, or equivalent education / experience is required.
* Recognized Internal Auditor training certificate (such as ISO 9001), current within the past two years is required.
* 2+ years of aviation and QA experience, with applicable training certification/s while working in an AMO or AOC or MRO environment is required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain necessary airport security clearance is required.
* Must maintain a valid passport (plus any necessary long-term visa for USA) and be able to travel to various locations worldwide when required.
* Knowledge of TCCA’s Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs) is required.
* Knowledge of FAA’s Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) is required.
* Knowledge/experience in IOSA auditing principles and ISARPs is a key asset.
* Knowledge/experience in AMOS (maintenance management software) is a key asset.
* Familiarity with various Technical Data sources (AMM, AIPC, CMM, MTCM) is a key asset.
* Experience in leading an audit team or a team conducting detailed engineering inspections is a key asset.
* Impartiality, integrity, tenacity, diplomacy and self-reliance are key attributes for this role.
* Excellence in time management, written and verbal communication skills, keen attention to detail.

Title: Safety Engineer
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Execute the Project HSE Plan, method statements, risk assessments (JSA/HAZID), and

COSHH controls; maintain evidence of competence and ensure resources for HSE are

adequate and sustained throughout the works

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings ,attend meetings, training sessions, and

workshops as required by KAHRAMAA.

* Enforce KAHRAMAA HSE rules at sites; support the HSE Manager/Coordinator in

developing the training matrix, audit/inspection plans, and coordination with KAHRAMAA on

HSE matters.

* Conduct site HSE inductions; lead toolbox talks; deliver/arrange topic-specific training

(Emergency Response & Preparedness, HAZMAT, Confined Space, Working at Height,

Lockout/Tagout, Electrical Safety, Lifting & Rigging, Power Tool Safety, Excavation Safety,

PPE, Waste Management, Incident Reporting & Investigation, Root Cause Analysis)

* Ensure appropriate PPE is issued, conforms to KAHRAMAA requirements, and is

inspected/maintained regularly (helmets, shoes, goggles/face shields, dust goggles, gloves,

harnesses/lifelines.)

* Maintain site housekeeping and safe storage/handling of materials, including

flammable/hazardous substances; implement controls for hot-work and welding areas with

suitable firefighting equipment.

* Keep portable firefighting equipment available on site from commencement to takeover;

ensure maintenance and mandatory weekly checks; recharge after use and manage stocks

of fresh charges; control open flames and flammable materials per KAHRAMAA instructions.

* Immediately notify KAHRAMAA of accidents/near misses; secure the site/witnesses; submit

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

Keep accident logs, patient/illness records, and periodic medical exam reporting as required

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

* Execute planned audits/inspections; issue NCRs; drive corrective/preventive actions;

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

and maintenance of LV and HV electricity meters and communication modules, including

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

installation in poor-signal areas (subject to KAHRAMAA approval)

* Ensure use of dedicated communication signal strength analyzers (no mobile apps

permitted) when validating AMI communications; coordinate safe handling/transport/storage

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

* Maintain daily/weekly/monthly safety reports, inspection logs, incident registers, training

records, and PPE registers; support project progress reporting cadence and WBS execution

phases (Engineering/Procurement/Execution/Close-out) with HSE inputs.

* Provide hard/soft copies of HSE documentation for audits and at KAHRAMAA’s request.

* Coordinate with KAHRAMAA HSE Department, line departments, customers, contractors,

and telecom providers for shutdowns, emergency works, and multi-site mobilization;

participate in emergency drills and ensure readiness of response teams.

* Maintain availability across three shifts in a 24×7 environment; travel between venues/depots

during and outside office hours for inspections, incident response, and verification of

corrective actions (as operationally required).

***Qualification & experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Pay: QAR8,000.00 - QAR11,000.00 per month

Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.
  
  
**Benefits For State Employees**
The state of South Carolina offers eligible employees generous benefits, including health and dental insurance; retirement and savings plan options; and paid vacation and sick leave. Plus, work-life balance programs such as telecommuting and flexible work schedules are available to employees of some state agencies.
  
  
**Insurance Benefits**
Eligible employees may enroll in health insurance, which includes prescription coverage and wellness benefits. Other available insurance benefits include dental, vision, term life insurance, long term disability and flexible spending accounts for health and child care expenses.
  
  
**Retirement Benefits**
State employees are also offered retirement plan options, including defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Additionally, eligible employees may elect to participate in the South Carolina Deferred Compensation Program, which is a voluntary, supplemental retirement savings plan offering 401(k) and 457 plan options.
  
  
**Workplace Benefits**
State employees may also be eligible for other benefits, including tuition assistance; holiday, annual and sick leave; and discounts on purchases, travel and more.
  
  
**Note:**
The benefits above are available to most state employees, with the exception of those in temporary positions. Employees in temporary grant and time-limited positions may be eligible for all, some or none of these benefits as benefits are associated with each position type. For these positions, contact the hiring agency to determine what benefits may be available.

Your primary responsibilities will be Supporting in Scope Platform and Products and developing use case scenarios, enhancing the security of Sun Life’s corporate and production systems. You will work closely with Enterprise Infrastructure, IT operations, Enterprise Architecture, and application development teams to identify risks to the business and lead security solutions to protect customer and financial information.

**What will you do?**

* Analyze information systems utilizing various cybersecurity techniques and lead security initiatives and enterprise level projects implementing security solutions and performing POC/POV for new technologies.
* Able to work independently with high degree of ambiguity and deliver expected outcomes, be focused on the end deliverables, and build trust with internal clients and peers.
* Responsible to deploy, support and maintain new and existing security technologies that are deployed within Sun Life and owned and supported by the team.
* Implement risk driven security controls and provide SME (Subject Matter Expertise) during Audit.
* Investigate and respond to security incidents, adhering to defined SLA’s. Participate in teams 24x7 on-call support and be required to join major incident management calls to provide support and consultation.
* Identify risks to the business and recommend strategies to address those risks.
* Manage the capacity and resiliency of security systems protecting Sun Life’s internal and client data.
* Collaborate and build trust with security peers, vendors, and other Sun Life teams to enhance security posture and best practices.
* A change catalyst for Digital transformation, using JIRA, Confluence, estimating stories, setting definition of done, completing and tracking story updates and assignments.
* Smoothly transition and operationalize projects and products. This includes developing roles & responsibilities (RACI), completing product documentation and educating the teams who will be performing BAU (Business as usual) the day-to-day work.
* Document, update and maintain cyber security playbooks, policies and knowledge base articles used to support the established Incident Management and CSIRT processes.
Continuously improve operational and security platform processes.

* An Information Technology University degree/college diploma in related discipline(s) or equivalent work experience
* Minimum 5-7 years Information security and engineering experience with enterprise level security technologies in the one or more areas of: Perimeter, Endpoints, Crypto, Cloud, Email Security, Security Visibility, and Automation and Orchestration
* Minimum 3-year experience in successfully leading global information security projects.
* Preferred: Certification(s) in data network engineering and/or security: CCNP/CCNP-Security, CCSP, CISSP, GIAC-GCIA, GIAC-GCED, Comptia, or equivalent security certification
* Experience in managing 3rd party security service providers in delivering security services.
